title: Abram Rescues Lot

questions.question: Who was captured by invading kings?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:12: They took Lot, who was dwelling in Sodom.

questions.question: What did Abram do when he heard Lot was captured?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:14-16: Abram led his men to rescue Lot and brought him back.

questions.question: Who blessed Abram after the battle?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:18-19: Melchizedek, king of Salem, blessed Abram.

questions.question: What did Abram give Melchizedek?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:20: Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

questions.question: What did Melchizedek bring out to Abram?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:18: Melchizedek brought out bread and wine.

questions.question: How many trained men did Abram lead?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:14: Abram led 318 trained men born in his house.

questions.question: Who was the leader of the invading kings?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:4-5: Chedorlaomer was the dominant king leading the alliance.

questions.question: What did the king of Sodom offer Abram after the rescue?
options: The goods, but asked for the people back
questions.correctAnswer: The goods, but asked for the people back
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:21: The king asked Abram to give him the people and keep the goods.

questions.question: What was Melchizedek's title?
options: King of Salem, priest of God Most High
questions.correctAnswer: King of Salem, priest of God Most High
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:18: Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

questions.question: How far did Abram pursue the enemy kings?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:14: Abram pursued them as far as Dan.

questions.question: How many kings were in the alliance that attacked Sodom?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:1-2: Four kings against five - Chedorlaomer led four allied kings.

questions.question: Why did Abram refuse the king of Sodom's offer?
options: So no one could say they made Abram rich
questions.correctAnswer: So no one could say they made Abram rich
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:23: "lest you should say, I have made Abram rich."

questions.question: What did Abram swear when refusing the spoils?
options: By the LORD, God Most High
questions.correctAnswer: By the LORD, God Most High
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:22: "I have lifted my hand to the LORD, God Most High."

questions.question: Where were the tar pits that some kings fell into?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:10: The Valley of Siddim was full of bitumen (tar) pits.

questions.question: Which allies of Abram went with him on the rescue mission?
questions.explanation: Genesis 14:13,24: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre were Abram's Amorite allies.

key_verse_text: And he blessed him and said, 'Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;'
